verdict.rationale: Ramp's spend-controls docs define funds as budgets restricted by amount, interval, allowed merchant categories, allowed merchants and countries, and these controls attach to issued cards. The marketing page says Ramp will "enforce spend limits, and block risky merchants or categories all before spend happens," which covers declining out-of-policy spend before purchase. Per-vendor limits on virtual cards are also described. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of point-of-sale decline behavior, evidence of automatic card locking on policy violation (lock appears only as a manual CLI/MCP action), and independent or hands-on corroboration.
